title: Let Androids Dream: From Visual Elements to Emergent Implications via Contextual Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2505.17019v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Image metaphor understanding differs from general VQA: the implied meaning is rarely explicit in pixels and instead emerges from the compositional interaction of visual elements together with social intent and culture-specific background. We identify missing context, namely conventions already in a model's weights that single-pass inference leaves unused and external facts absent from the weights, as a failure mode of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). translated_title: 让仿生人做梦：通过上下文对齐从视觉元素到涌现的隐含意义
translated_abstract: 图像隐喻理解与一般视觉问答（VQA）不同：其隐含意义很少直接显现在像素之中，而是从视觉元素的组合交互、社会意图以及文化特定的背景中涌现出来。我们识别出“上下文缺失”——即模型权重中已存在但单次推理未能利用的既有惯例，以及权重中缺失的外部事实——是多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的一种失败模式。我们将“上下文对齐”形式化为对潜在上下文的推理：选择与图像构图相关且有助于推断其隐含意义的背景知识。随后，我们提出了 Let Androids Dream（LAD），一个无需训练的框架，通过测试时计算来实现上下文对齐：（1）感知提取组合性视觉结构；（2）搜索自适应地从参数化知识或网络搜索中获取上下文；（3）推理将……
tldr: 该论文提出无需训练的 LAD 框架，通过感知、搜索与推理三阶段的测试时计算实现上下文对齐，使多模态大模型能够理解图像隐喻中涌现的隐含意义。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LAD, a training-free framework that enables multimodal large language models to understand emergent metaphorical implications in images by performing contextual alignment via test-time computation through perception, adaptive search, and reasoning.
